conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 7. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.1 | 5.5 | 250 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.3 | 4.7 | 250 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 13.8 | 6.9 | 250 |
